ObstacleDetection.description:
How eagerly the mower avoids obstacles during a native job (``MowPattern``).

Which modes a mower offers depends on its model and firmware
(``MowerCapabilities.start_options.obstacle_detection``). The names follow the vendor apps:
``off`` is the plain bump-and-turn behaviour, ``standard`` avoids obstacles it sees ahead,
``sensitive`` additionally avoids areas that are not lawn; ``slow_touch`` and
``less_touch`` exist only on older firmware.
ObstacleDetection.title: ObstacleDetection

PermissionDef.description:
A permission a module defines, e.g. ``mower.control``.

Keys that have a relation in the authorization model are checked per object in OpenFGA.
Other keys are coarse, account-wide permissions carried in the access token (``perms``) and
checked with ``require_permission``. ``implied_by`` lets such a key follow an existing one:
whoever holds every listed key on the whole account also holds this key.

implied_by.description: Keys that imply this one when held on the whole account (e.g. `device_gateway.view` implied by `mower.view`).
implied_by.title: Implied By

SchedulePattern.description:
The start settings one schedule sets for each of its runs (ADR 0024 amendment of
2026-10-24): the keys of :class:`MowPattern` that make sense for a recurring job, each
optional. A key left out (None) is not part of the schedule: the run takes it from the
mower's mow defaults in Fleet, and without those the mower keeps its own setting (for the
pattern, angle and border laps the clients' fallback, stripes at 0 degrees with one lap).

``start_progress_pct`` is not offered: it skips the first part of one job's route, which
only makes sense to resume an interrupted job, never for every run of a schedule.

Which values fit one mower is decided with its :class:`MowerCapabilities`
(:meth:`problem`); a group schedule must fit every mower of the group.

angle_deg.description: Base angle in degrees; null: the mow defaults'. A schedule's `rotation_angles` replace it run by run; with `rotation_step_deg` it is the angle of the first run, later runs turn the last angle by the step (ADR 0061).

get.description:
Where the mowing angle rotation of a mower stands (ADR 0061): the last angle per area
(from scheduled runs and manual starts with rotation chosen) and the step the start sheet
offers for manual starts. `can_view` on the mower.

post.description:
A manual start with rotation chosen sent `angle_deg` for `area_ids`: the next run of
these areas continues from it. A start with an explicit angle is not reported.
`can_control` on the mower.

put.description: Set the rotation step of manual starts (null: off). `can_control` on the mower.

get.description:
What the iOS schedule and weather widgets show for one mower (ADR 0059): the next runs
(at most 3), the verdict of the rain pause for now (`runs`, `rain_pause`, `unsure`) and a few
rain facts. `can_view` on the mower; schedules the caller may not see are left out.
Schedules of the caller's account whose target (mower or group) the caller may view.

post.description:
A new schedule: ``can_edit_schedule`` and ``can_control`` on the target (403 when the
target is visible, 404 otherwise, also for a target of another account). The caller becomes
the owner; every firing re-checks the owner's ``can_control``.

delete.description: Delete a schedule and its runs (``can_edit_schedule`` on the target).

get.description: One schedule (``can_view`` on its target, 404 otherwise).

patch.description:
Change a schedule (``can_edit_schedule`` and ``can_control`` on the old and a new
target); the caller becomes the owner and the next run is recomputed.

get.description: The next firings and the rain decision for the first one (``can_view``).

post.description:
Start the schedule now on behalf of the caller (``can_control`` on the target, checked
again per mower by Fleet). ``respect_rain=true`` applies the rain pause. The next firing
stays as it is.

get.description:
Run records of the schedule, newest first (``can_view`` on the target); pass
``next_before`` as ``before`` for the next page.

post.description: Skip the next firing (recorded as ``skipped_manual``); 409 without a next run.

get.description: The rain decision for the mower now and the forecast hours it used (``can_view``).
